player_prompt.intro:
A nyi azɔnwla {player_id} he ɖo xɔxɛ Pig Dice tɔn.

Gbɛsɛ:
- Le a xɔ ɖo, a ku kpɔ 'ɖo [roll]' alo 'ɖo [hold]'
- Ɖo ɖa 2-6: Ku a xɔ ɖo dɔdɔ mɛ
- Ɖo ɖa 1: Ku a xɔ ɖo dɔdɔ mɛ bɔ ku ɖo xɔ ɖo
- Ɖo gbɛ: Ku a xɔ ɖo dɔdɔ mɛ bɔ a akɔnta mɛ ku ɖo xɔ ɖo
- Ɖitɛtɛ ɖo {winning_score} akɔnta mɛ wu

Le a xɔ ɖo, a na mɔ akɔnta mɛ kpo bɔ a xɔ ɖo dɔdɔ mɛ.
Ɖɔ 'ɖo [roll]' nɛ a ɖo ɖɛɖɛ alo 'ɖo [hold]' nɛ a sɛ akɔnta mɛ.
